_comment: Unified server config for Paws & Parcels. Copy this file to `server_config.json`, fill in the secret values (db.password, auth.jwtSecret), and edit anything else you need. `server_config.json` is gitignored — never commit it.

server._comment_staticDir: Directory (relative to project root) of the built client to serve from this same process — single-host hosting (client + API + WebSocket on one port). Empty string disables it. PaaS hosts (Render/Railway/Fly) override the listen port via the $PORT env var automatically.

db._comment_file: Path to the SQLite database file (relative to the project root). The file is created + migrated on first server boot and is committed to the repo.

oidc._comment_clientId: Registered client_id in Ashat Hub's oauth_clients table (seeded for Paws & Parcels).
oidc._comment_redirectUri: Must exactly match one of the redirect_uris registered on the Ashat side (Vite serves public/oidc-callback.html at this URL in dev).
oidc._comment_scopes: OpenID Connect scopes requested at the authorize endpoint.
oidc._comment_discoveryUrl: Ashat Hub's OIDC discovery document — the server reads authorization/token/jwks endpoints from it (cached).
oidc._comment_issuer: The exact `iss` claim the server verifies id_tokens against. Ashat issues iss = {baseUrl}/api/oauth (note: discovery.issuer omits the /api/oauth suffix — keep this in sync with Ashat's actual issuer).
oidc._comment_jwksTtlSeconds: How long the JWKS + discovery documents are cached before re-fetching (seconds).
